repeat_issue_flags.method: category_2_0 grouping across open tickets + closed-last-90-days tickets, count >= 2. Note: nearly all 37 closed/completed tickets on this account show hs_lastmodifieddate within the last 90 days (mid-Jul through late-Aug 2026), even though many were created back in 2023-2025 — almost certainly a byproduct of a recent bulk pinned-note refresh (e.g. a /ticket-groom pass) rather than genuine reopened activity. That means this grouping is effectively the account's full multi-year ticket history by category, not a true 90-day repeat-issue signal — a human should sanity-check before presenting any of these as a recent pattern. The 'false' category is a literal unset/default field value, not a real category label — flagged for data hygiene, not as a genuine issue pattern.
